quote: ANR is a method for enhancing the establishment of secondary forest from degraded grassland and shrub vegetation by protecting and nurturing mother trees and their wildlings inherently present in the area.

context.practice_as_described: Assisted natural regeneration of secondary forest on degraded grassland/shrub vegetation, protecting and nurturing existing mother trees and wildlings.
context.intended_use: T4 source criteria pending human review; no executable suitability function or default weight.
context.note: Country case/practice guidance, not a validated global suitability model. Related WOCAT technologies 1705 and 1729 are separate records and were not extracted. ITTO2020 Danao case is a companion account, not independent evidence.
context.numeric_calibration: No EO class codes, scores or weights. Degraded former forest context is essential; do not license conversion of native grassland or shrub ecosystems.
context.review_needed: Confirm ANR host-system classes and locally verified degraded-forest history; approval does not activate a generic grassland mask.

attribution: WOCAT approach 1971, compiled by Philippine Overview of Conservation Approaches and Technologies from field visits and land-user interviews. Danao, Bohol, 2006–2009; same case as ITTO2020 case study 4, not independent replication.

model_use.note: Explicit site-identification guidance for ANR; existing regeneration is assessed. Not a fitted spatial model. Broad categorical regeneration potential only; density, height and spread have no exact VONT mappings.

context.numeric_calibration: Retain literal ideal-site ranges together. No hard exclusions, scores, interpolation, monotonic density response or opt_low/opt_high inferred. Nursery supply, seed-source distance and FMNR rootstock are not substituted.
context.review_needed: Confirm use of broad regeneration_potential for existing wildlings in assisted regeneration. Exact density/height/spread mappings and country transfer remain holds; approval cannot activate numeric thresholds.
